name: Arsène Wenger

spellsCounted.reason: Ligue 1 1987-88, Coupe de France 1991; spell decided by user. Only 'summer 1987' and 'September 1994' found in sources; the day-level dates 1987-07-01 and 1994-09-17 are the user's/unconfirmed (start day is an approximation).
Premier League 1997-98, 2001-02, 2003-04; FA Cups; end is the date of his last match (Huddersfield 0-1 Arsenal), announced departure effective at end of 2017/18

scopeNote: Two counted spells: Monaco 1987 to September 1994 and Arsenal 1996-10-01 to 2018-05-13. Monaco: tactical coverage is thin (only retrospective Hateley/Hoddle/Bergkamp accounts, no dedicated tactical study found; a Set Pieces/Planet Football/AS Monaco set); no source gives a formation or zonal/man marking for Monaco. Arsenal: first-decade rigid 4-4-2 (sweeping back four inherited from George Graham, offside trap), a fluid 4-4-2 in 2001-04 (Invincibles; sources call it 4-4-2 with Bergkamp dropping, Henry drifting left), a 4-5-1/4-3-3 possession phase after 2005 (Emirates), a deeper block and 4-2-3-1 from 2011-12, counter-attacking big-game plan in 2014-16. Set pieces: man-marking policy until 2011 and zonal from 2011/12, then mixed. Popular label 'total football/possession-based since 1996' (Woolwich Arsenal blog) is contradicted by 1997-2001 accounts of a direct, counter-attacking team. Monaco start and Arsenal start/end days are partly approximate; see openQuestions. Excluded Nagoya start is given only as 1995 (day not needed, spell excluded). Event ranges in the sources were reduced to a representative single year (e.g. 1987-1994 recollections dated 1991).
openQuestions: Monaco start day not found (sources say summer 1987; 1987-07-01 is an approximation). Monaco end day 1994-09-17 not confirmed by any source read (World Soccer Talk and Irish Times say only 1994, 17th in the table, dismissed).

Arsenal start: user date 1996-10-01 matches Pain in the Arsenal (appointed 30 Sept, assumed the position the next day); OnlineGooner says tenure began 30 September and confirmation came 17 September 1996.
Arsenal end: 2018-05-13 is the final match (FourFourTwo); the contract end date was not read.

Wenger and Monaco's man vs zonal defending is not documented in any tier A-B source found; Arsenal's set-piece marking is man-marking until 2011, zonal trial from Sept 2011, mixed afterwards (Mellberg).

Coaches' Voice, These Football Times and Set Pieces tactical pieces were not returned by site: searches; the tactical sources used are Hard Tackle, Spielverlagerung, Football Faithful, Sportskeeda, Left-Sided Problem (tier B), and the Spielverlagerung match report is about Leicester's defence mostly.

Invincibles pressing: Football Faithful says Henry-Bergkamp pairing closed down centre-backs while wide midfielders pressed periodically; Sportskeeda says no counter-pressing. No contradiction on intensity, both say moderate.
